style: Read this aloud as a warm, friendly, genuinely human guide showing one business owner around their software, like a helpful friend who is a little excited to show them something. Relaxed but lively pace, natural, a smile in the voice, gentle emphasis. Not salesy, not robotic. Say only the words below.

lines: Everything you are about to see was recorded live in the real app, and all of it is included in your AppSumo lifetime deal.
First, AI Autopilot. Describe a business once, and it builds it and runs it.
Here is a quick look around.
This is the board. Every business you look after gets its own business workspace, with its own goal, workflows, prospects and website.
Allowances are counted live, so you always see this month’s posts and prospects against your plan.
If you are an agency, each client stays in its own account. Switch between them here, or open the agency dashboard to see them all.
And all of this works on the server every five minutes, whether this page is open or not.
Here are five businesses: a caterer, a gym, a law firm, a dentist and a real estate team. Each one runs its own plan, completely independent of the others.
Put the business that matters most on top, or pause a whole business in one click.
And share progress with each client on a read-only page. They never see your other clients, contacts or prices.
Now let us build a new one. Just chat with your AI Live Business Manager: type, or send a voice note. If the business has a website, it reads it for you.
These are real AI answers, in seconds. It only asks what it still needs, with answers you can tap.
Then it suggests solutions that fit the business. Include one in a click, or say no thanks. Each one is something Autopilot can really run.
Then it writes the plan for AI Autopilot: one smart instruction, built from everything it has learned.
Read it and change anything. Company, customers, objectives, constraints: it is all in plain words.
Add a sentence, and the whole plan is rewritten. Or press Write it again for a fresh version.
It tells you what it understood. If something is wrong, just say so in your own words.
Add more work in a click: branded social posts every day, or an SEO article every week.
Now it asks only the questions it could not answer itself. Each one comes with suggestions, or you can let AI decide, and it tells you why.
Its own website or funnel is already in its name. Every design shows the business’s name, colour and photo.
A couple more quick answers, and we are ready.
Now read exactly what it is going to build: the workflows, the AI agents and the schedules, before anything exists.
Want something different? Change the blueprint just by saying it. No going back through the questions.
It only builds what this business actually uses. Anything not connected yet simply waits, and the rest starts now.
And nothing that contacts a person switches on without you. Emails and texts arrive as drafts for you to read first.
Built. And every record is real: its emails are written, the prospect search has started, and drafts are waiting for you.
There it is. The new business, live on the board.
Let us look inside one business.
Vine Street Kitchen. Its goal, its money and its work, at a glance.
Workflows are drawn the way they run. Every fork is labelled yes or no, and every path joins back up.
Open any step to see the real message and condition, built on your own forms, tags and stages. Nothing generic.
You can dry-run a step against a real contact. Nothing is sent. It shows you exactly which way they would go, and why.
Change the whole workflow in place. Add a step anywhere, reorder them, or change what starts it.
Or just describe a workflow in plain words. Edit with AI writes it for this business, in its own voice.
It is written in seconds, and it arrives switched off. Nothing reaches anybody until you have read it.
Read it, then switch it on. From then on it runs on the server, every five minutes.
Now, how each business keeps moving.
AI agents work on a schedule. They read the business and write for it, and every piece is a draft.
Here is every step it is on the hook for: emails, conditions, texts and agents, across the live workflows.
Ideas it finds wait for your yes. Here, it spotted twenty-two past clients nobody had asked about spring.
You decide what it may do by itself: off, ask first, or on its own, for each business separately.
This is its plan for today, item by item.
One approval, and it goes ahead. It is sent from the business’s own mailbox, and logged as it happens.
Everything it did is out in the open: what is going on now, and what is coming up.
And you can see when each workflow runs next.
Every day it re-plans every business. It reads it, writes, builds and sends, then plans again.
It spots problems before you ask: deals gone quiet, follow-ups missing, a list that vanished. Named, never hidden.
Every business finds its own new leads. Brightline’s daily search reads each website and checks each address.
And everything it made is in one place, with a shortcut to the module that owns it.
And it keeps watch. Your AI Live Business Manager checks every campaign, every day.
Here, Brightline’s outreach sent forty-six emails in ten days. None failed, and nobody replied.
So it tells you: this campaign isn’t getting replies. You hear it in the app and by email, with what it would change.
One click, and AI re-optimises it: new emails, subject lines and timing, in the business’s own voice.
Nothing changes until you approve it. The new version arrives switched off, so you read it first.
Or talk it through in the live chat, on every screen. It asks about your business, and suggests what to try.
Each client has its own website, built from whole-site templates and published on its own address.
And its own funnels. Summit’s quote funnel was built by AI Autopilot a minute ago.
Or start from a ready-made workflow. Preview it, then use it.
That is AI Autopilot. Describe it once, and it builds it and runs it.
Next, AI Prospecting: new leads from one sentence, every day.
Just say who you sell to, in one sentence. There are no filters to learn.
It searches live, reads the websites and checks every address.
You see what it did, step by step.
Then keep only the addresses worth sending to: the ones that take mail, have a phone, or a website.
Now turn the search into a daily finder. An AI Autopilot business workspace runs it on a schedule, by itself.
Decide what counts as a lead.
Choose how often, and how many: every day, weekdays, or the days you pick.
Every prospect is checked before it is added.
And you choose where they go: a list, a tag, a pipeline, or straight into the next workflow.
Connected. New prospects every day, and nobody has to remember to search.
Then everything you need to sell and convert: pipelines, websites, funnels, booking pages and email sequences.
In Contacts, open anybody and see their whole story on one page: health score, stage, deals, notes and email.
Subject lines are written for this person, from their name, their company and whatever you have typed so far.
Pick one, and it is in the subject box.
In Pipelines, describe the work, and AI lays out the stages from what the business sells, and to whom.
Every stage comes with its first tasks, and exactly what applying would change. No deal is ever deleted.
Rename, reorder, rewrite. It is a draft, and nothing changes until you press Apply.
Then ask Brain about the board. The AI answers from these deals, and the suggestion chips are counted exactly.
Pipelines: every deal, from first enquiry to won.
Each business workspace gets its own pipeline, with its first tasks written for that business.
Website enquiries become deals by themselves. A visitor asks for a quote on the business’s website...
and it is on the board in seconds. A contact and a deal, in the first stage, with nobody typing anything.
Automations work the board for you. Here, any deal idle for fourteen days is flagged urgent and stale.
Drag a deal on, or open it for sub-tasks, deadlines and comments.
And see it your way: board, list, table, funnel or timeline.
In Email campaigns, a whole campaign is written from a brief, for the client you pick, from their business profile.
Three emails, timed and conditioned. It stops when they answer.
And it tells you when it has too little to go on. A thin business profile is named, not papered over.
Ask the AI to change any email: shorter, warmer, more direct, or a different subject line.
Or build an automation from one sentence. Describe it, and it builds the trigger, the waits, the emails and the tags.
Built as a draft, step by step. Read it on the canvas, then switch it on.
Email campaigns go out from your own mailbox.
Every figure is counted from real sends: opened, clicked, replied and bounced, campaign by campaign.
Sequences send several emails, days apart, each from your own address.
And they stop the moment somebody answers.
A/B test any step, with two versions side by side.
Read it as one real contact will get it, every merge field filled in.
Everything is logged: who was added, and what changed.
And bring your own list. Any spreadsheet becomes contacts you can use anywhere.
In Websites, every client’s site is edited right on the page.
Say what the section should say, and Generate with AI writes the headline, the line under it, and the buttons.
Rewritten in seconds, in the site’s own design. Change any word by hand afterwards.
Websites and funnels for every client, built and hosted in the app.
Start from a whole site, not a blank page. Hover over a template to scroll through it.
Click anything on the page to change it, right in the panel beside it.
Add a section in one click: content and forms, straight onto the page.
Add pages, and check them on a tablet and a phone before they go live.
Get it ready for search engines: its title, description, and the link people share.
Then publish. It is live in a click.
Booking pages that fill your calendar, with every booking in one list.
Edit it beside the real thing. The page your visitors see changes as you type.
Change the look in one click, with four themes for the same page.
Set how long, where, and which days: video call, phone, or in person.
Times are shown in each visitor’s own time zone, so there is no back-and-forth.
Check it on a phone before you share it.
Set your hours, and the emails go by themselves: confirmations, reschedule links, and a note to you for every booking.
Creating content: graphics for every post, and SEO blog articles on a schedule.
In the Graphics Designer, say what the post is about, and AI writes the design: headline, label, points and button, fitted to the template.
Not right? Rewrite the words. Prices and dates are never invented.
Or describe a whole design from scratch, and it lays it out and opens it in the editor.
Every template is drawn with your client’s name and colours.
There are templates for whatever you are posting: offers, launches, tips and announcements.
Pick one, and say what it is about. Offers and prices only ever come from what you type.
Change the words, and the design keeps its shape.
Every format is re-laid, never stretched: feed, square, story and landscape.
Your client’s brand, in a click.
Swap the picture, from the photo library or your own.
Or try the same words in another composition.
And it is ready to post: caption, hashtags, and a reminder date.
For the blog, give it the writing you already have: an about page, a service page, or an old post.
It reads the business and builds a ranking strategy: what you sell, to whom, and the terms worth chasing.
Keywords come in clusters, each aimed at a page, with an honest difficulty estimate.
Then a month of posts is planned, cheapest to rank first.
Each post is written in the business’s voice: over a thousand words, with headings and internal links.
It is measured against nine on-page SEO checks. A failing check is shown, not hidden.
Then it is published to WordPress, on the planned dates, only once you approve.
And running an agency: a sub-account for every client, under your own name.
A workspace for every client, under your own name.
A client workspace takes a minute, with its own contacts, pipelines and campaigns, and the price they pay you.
Each client can see the product name you sell it under, right on their sign-in page.
Your product name appears across the app: the top bar, the sign-in screen, and the emails’ sender name.
And your own sign-in address goes live at once.
Reports read live from every module, counted from your own records.
Pick any period you like, from seven days to twelve months.
See where every contact came from.
Deals by stage, and who is winning them.
Every campaign side by side.
And whether your mail is arriving.
Here is what each tier includes. Stack up to three codes for more business workspaces, workflows, AI requests and client sub-accounts.
Everything you saw in this film is part of the deal, with your AI Live Business Manager watching over it every day.
